The single registration surface used by engine plugins. Plugin-local ids are exposed as `<plugin-id>.<local-id>`.

# Declaration

```cpp
class EnginePluginRegistrar {
    public:
        EnginePluginRegistrar(std::string plugin_id, API::SDK_API* api)
            : plugin_id_(std::move(plugin_id)), api_(api) {
            if (plugin_id_.empty()) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("EnginePluginRegistrar requires a plugin id.");
            }
        }

        std::string addModule(PluginModuleType definition) {
            const auto local_id = validateLocalId(definition.id, "module");
            definition.id = qualify(local_id);
            if (definition.name.empty()) {
                definition.name = local_id;
            }
            modules_.push_back(definition);
            addContribution("modules", definition.id, definition.name, {
                {"configPath", definition.config_path},
                {"defaultParametersPath", definition.default_parameters_path}
            });
            return definition.id;
        }

        std::string addTask(
            std::string local_id,
            std::string name,
            API::TaskTypeDefinition definition
        ) {
            local_id = validateLocalId(local_id, "task");
            const auto id = qualify(local_id);
            definition.metadata.task_type = id;
            definition.metadata.exposed_from = "plugin";
            definition.metadata.expected_plugin_id = plugin_id_;
            addContribution("tasks", id, normalizedName(std::move(name), local_id));
            if (api_ != nullptr) {
                api_->registerTaskType(definition);
            }
            return id;
        }

        std::string addDCodeFunction(
            std::string local_id,
            std::string name,
            API::DCodeFunctionHandler handler,
            std::string doc = {},
            std::vector<API::DCodeFunctionArgument> input_arguments = {},
            std::vector<API::DCodeFunctionArgument> output_arguments = {}
        ) {
            local_id = validateLocalId(local_id, "DCode function");
            const auto id = qualify(local_id);
            addContribution("dcodeFunctions", id, normalizedName(std::move(name), local_id), {{"description", doc}});
            if (api_ != nullptr) {
                api_->registerDCodeFunction(
                    id,
                    std::move(handler),
                    std::move(doc),
                    std::move(input_arguments),
                    std::move(output_arguments)
                );
            }
            return id;
        }

        std::string addOperation(
            std::string local_id,
            std::string name,
            API::OperationHandler handler
        ) {
            local_id = validateLocalId(local_id, "operation");
            const auto id = qualify(local_id);
            addContribution("operations", id, normalizedName(std::move(name), local_id));
            if (api_ != nullptr) {
                api_->registerOperation(id, std::move(handler));
            }
            return id;
        }

        std::string addSchematicTemplate(
            std::string local_id,
            std::string name,
            std::string path
        ) {
            local_id = validateLocalId(local_id, "schematic template");
            if (path.empty()) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("A schematic template path is required.");
            }
            const auto id = qualify(local_id);
            addContribution(
                "schematicTemplates",
                id,
                normalizedName(std::move(name), local_id),
                {{"path", std::move(path)}}
            );
            return id;
        }

        std::string addRuntimeService(
            std::string local_id,
            std::string name,
            PluginRuntimeService service
        ) {
            local_id = validateLocalId(local_id, "runtime service");
            const auto id = qualify(local_id);
            addContribution("runtimeServices", id, normalizedName(std::move(name), local_id));
            if (api_ != nullptr) {
                if (service.on_start) api_->onStart(id, service.on_start);
                if (service.on_loop) api_->onLoop(id, service.on_loop);
                if (service.on_end) api_->onEnd(id, service.on_end);
            }
            return id;
        }

        const std::vector<PluginModuleType>& moduleTypes() const {
            return modules_;
        }

        nlohmann::json contributionsJson() const {
            nlohmann::json engine = {
                {"modules", nlohmann::json::array()},
                {"tasks", nlohmann::json::array()},
                {"dcodeFunctions", nlohmann::json::array()},
                {"operations", nlohmann::json::array()},
                {"schematicTemplates", nlohmann::json::array()},
                {"runtimeServices", nlohmann::json::array()}
            };
            for (const auto& [category, entries] : contributions_) {
                for (const auto& entry : entries) {
                    auto json_entry = nlohmann::json{{"id", entry.id}, {"name", entry.name}};
                    for (const auto& [key, value] : entry.details.items()) {
                        if (!value.is_null() && !(value.is_string() && value.get<std::string>().empty())) {
                            json_entry[key] = value;
                        }
                    }
                    engine[category].push_back(std::move(json_entry));
                }
            }
            return {{"engine", std::move(engine)}};
        }

    private:
        std::string plugin_id_;
        API::SDK_API* api_ = nullptr;
        std::vector<PluginModuleType> modules_;
        std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<PluginContribution>>> contributions_;
        std::unordered_set<std::string> ids_;

        std::string qualify(const std::string& local_id) const {
            return plugin_id_ + "." + local_id;
        }

        std::string validateLocalId(const std::string& value, const char* kind) {
            if (value.empty()) {
                throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("A local ") + kind + " id is required.");
            }
            if (value.find('.') != std::string::npos || value.find('/') != std::string::npos || value.find('\\') != std::string::npos) {
                throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("Local ") + kind + " id '" + value + "' must not contain '.', '/', or '\\'.");
            }
            const auto canonical_id = qualify(value);
            if (!ids_.insert(canonical_id).second) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Duplicate plugin contribution id '" + canonical_id + "'.");
            }
            return value;
        }

        static std::string normalizedName(std::string name, const std::string& fallback) {
            return name.empty() ? fallback : std::move(name);
        }

        void addContribution(
            const std::string& category,
            std::string id,
            std::string name,
            nlohmann::json details = nlohmann::json::object()
        ) {
            auto it = std::find_if(contributions_.begin(), contributions_.end(), [&](const auto& value) {
                return value.first == category;
            });
            if (it == contributions_.end()) {
                contributions_.push_back({category, {}});
                it = std::prev(contributions_.end());
            }
            it->second.push_back({std::move(id), std::move(name), std::move(details)});
        }
    }
```

        std::string name;
        nlohmann::json details = nlohmann::json::object();
    }

        std::function<void()> on_loop;
